biotools.summary: doubletrouble is an R/Bioconductor package for identifying, classifying, and analyzing gene and genome duplications. It detects duplication modes, calculates substitution rates, and provides visualization tools, with a user-friendly web interface for exploring duplicated gene repertoires across eukaryotic genomes.
